info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Methods-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods Retrieval API provides a comprehensive list of available payment methods for processing transactions. This endpoint enables applications to access and display payment options to users, ensuring that customers have the necessary choices to complete their purchases. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, financial applications, and payment processors seeking to enhance their checkout experience. Integration with this API facilitates seamless transaction flows by allowing users to select their preferred payment methods.

get.description: Fetches a list of available payment methods for processing transactions. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of the payment options that users can choose from while making a purchase.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for retrieving available payment methods. It may include various filters or settings relevant to the payment methods being requested.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
